rule: Encounter = aggro gate + group wake + leash. Aggro is a per-tick scan with a check budget and a rotating start, so cost stays flat as candidates grow. The group wakes through a shared aggro table filtered by package id, and only newly added members count as a pull. A stealth flag gates aggro: the mob stays hidden until it takes a hit. Patrol is a small guard group on one shared route with index-based spacing and formation offsets. The lair is a boss with zero roam range, a size swell while it has a target, and one retreat per life at a health threshold. Camp XP falls by a fixed step per kill and resets after an age threshold. Defects: camp bonus reset is one step low (D1, likely); patrol creation ignores existing guards (D2, latent); boss return drops its speed argument (D3, minor).

look_test: On a 375-wide phone in one zone: (1) one stealth creature in grass that is hidden until hit; judge the reveal. (2) A patrol trio (fighter, archer, healer) on a shared route spaced a few hundred units apart; judge whether they read as one unit and who is who. (3) A leashed boss that swells while engaged and retreats once at 60 percent; judge whether the swell is readable and whether the retreat reads as the boss leaving.
